facts.status_note: The directory marks the lookout removed; no source describes what remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: Only one source covers this site: the Oregon Lookouts directory. The county index cuts off the section number (4S-6W-), so section 8 rests on the site page alone. No NHLR, firelookout.com or Forest Service record turned up in searches or the local caches. Other Stony Mountain pages in the caches are for other states. Stony Point is a separate directory entry and firelookout.com entry, not this site. The story is short because the evidence is one directory entry; it is below the roughly 120-word guide floor and is left that way rather than padded.
